entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (thumb) now is in a smaller splint, and the Bucs will see if he can progress to gripping the football next week, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Camden Brown
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Carsen Ryan
entries.summary: Ryan (calf) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Bears, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Darius Slayton
entries.summary: Slayton (knee) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) is doing rehab work on a side field at Friday's practice, EJ Smith of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

entries.name: Jalen Nailor
entries.summary: Nailor (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at New England, Paul Gutierrez of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Justin Joly
entries.summary: Joly (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Bengals.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (toe) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Falcons, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.

entries.name: Mack Hollins
entries.summary: Hollins (calf) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: Mariota (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: A trade for Harrison will not be completed "until after Sunday's games are played," but the Cardinals "feel comfortable enough" knowing it will occur that they will deactivate him for Sunday's game against the Lions, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman is expected to miss multiple weeks after aggravating his foot injury, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports Thursday.

entries.name: Quentin Johnston
entries.summary: Johnston (chest) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Denver.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley (hamstring) wasn't spotted at Friday's practice, EJ Smith of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

entries.name: Stefon Diggs
entries.summary: Diggs (hamstring) wasn't spotted at Friday's practice, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: Wallace (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: Thornton is slated to undergo surgery later this week to address the dislocated left ankle he sustained in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders and is facing an expected recovery timeline of 3-to-4 months, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Trey Lance
entries.summary: Lance (groin) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

entries.name: Alvin Kamara
entries.summary: Kamara (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ashton Jeanty
entries.summary: Jeanty (ankle/foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, with Raiders coach Klint Kubiak saying Friday that the running back will "do his best to go," Levi Edwards of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Barion Brown
entries.summary: Brown (thigh) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Emily Leiker of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Williams (hamstring) was a limited practice participant Friday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Green Bay.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: Tate (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans.

entries.name: CeeDee Lamb
entries.summary: Lamb is believed to be dealing with a "quad bruise" that is "not considered to be serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Kolar (forearm) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

entries.name: Colbie Young
entries.summary: Young (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: David Martin-Robinson
entries.summary: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) was on the field for the start of Saturday's practice, Joe Buscaglia of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: Holani (ribs/knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

entries.name: Ja'Marr Chase
entries.summary: Chase remains in concussion protocol and will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Miami, Charlie Goldsmith of Fox 19 Now Cincinnati reports.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: The Panthers are hopeful that Coker (quadriceps) will be ready to return to action following their Week 5 bye, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Addison (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game in New Orleans, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Joshua Palmer
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Justin Jefferson
entries.summary: Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) were at practice Friday, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Keenan Allen
entries.summary: Allen (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Denver, while teammate Quentin Johnston (chest) has been ruled out.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
entries.summary: Stevenson (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts, Mike DeFabo reports.

entries.name: Tee Higgins
entries.summary: Higgins (groin/neck) was a full practice participant Friday but is still listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Miami, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: McLaurin (hamstring), who officially is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest against the Giants, will be a game-time decision, as Jeremy Fowler of ESPN highlighted Friday in a Week 5 injury update on SportsCenter.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday night's game against the Falcons.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) was seen in the locker room Wednesday without a noticeable limp, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Ben Yurosek
entries.summary: Yurosek (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.

entries.name: Braxton Berrios
entries.summary: The Giants placed Berrios (foot) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers could open Kirk's (calf) practice window to return from injured reserve in two weeks, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: Gabriel (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Paul Gutierrez of Raiders.com reports.

entries.name: Durham Smythe
entries.summary: The Ravens placed Smythe (Achilles) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Long (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Friday that Lane (wrist) is "doing really well" and "has put himself in a great position to be ready to roll when the time permits."

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Lane (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Bryant (ankle) was placed on the Broncos' injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Savion Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Tank Bigsby
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Bigsby (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is expected to be ready to return after his four-game stint on injured reserve, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Tim Patrick
entries.summary: Patrick (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns.

entries.name: Trevor Etienne
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Etienne (ankle) will "for sure" be back following the Panthers' Week 5 bye, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (thumb) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
